biotools.summary: iDNA-OpenPrompt is a software resource utilizing an OpenPrompt learning framework for identifying DNA methylation sites. The model combines prompt templates, a BERT tokenizer, and pre-trained language models to improve accuracy and efficiency compared to traditional methods.
